_description: Chipset → IC mapping database for mobile repair diagnostics. Sources: MediaTek PCB design manuals, Wikipedia, datasheets, technician input.

fan53526.actual_ic: May be MT6691ZXP on some boards

logo_stuck_i2c_bus3.symptom: Phone stuck on logo, does not boot to Android
logo_stuck_i2c_bus3.root_cause: MT6691ZXP / fan53526 (EMI VDDQ voltage regulator) IC dead or bad solder
repair_steps: Check MT6691ZXP solder joints under microscope
Check inductor and capacitor around DRAM regulator

MT6370.function: Charger IC + LED Flash + Display Bias

fan53526.notes: Often replaced by MT6691ZXP on board

MT6691ZXP.notes: Board-level replacement for fan53526. Driver probes as fan53526 at 0x60

i2c_address_map.0x50: MT6691ZXP alt addr / EEPROM / Camera OTP
i2c_address_map.0x6B: RT5738 alt / BQ25601 / SGM41511 (VDD2 or charger)

dead_phone_no_power.symptom: Phone completely dead, no response to power button or charging
indicators: No data received on serial port

possible_causes.reason: PMIC dead or shorted — no power distribution

possible_causes.check: Measure battery voltage with multimeter (should be 3.7-4.2V)
Check CPU power rails (VPROC, VCORE) with multimeter
Connect DC power supply — if current > 500mA immediately = short. Use thermal camera to find hot spot

repair_steps: Connect DC power supply, check current draw
If high current = find short with thermal camera
If no current = check PMIC, replace if dead
If battery dead = charge externally or replace

logo_stuck_boot_loop.symptom: Phone shows logo but does not boot to Android, stuck on logo or keeps restarting
indicators: Kernel boots but Android init fails
Boot stage reaches Kernel but not Zygote/SystemServer

possible_causes.reason: RAM voltage unstable — Android crashes during heavy RAM usage
possible_causes.check: Check I2C bus 3 errors in boot log, measure EMI VDDQ (0.6V) and VDD2 (1.125V)
Check storage init in boot log, try flashing firmware

possible_causes.reason: CPU solder joint broken — intermittent connection
possible_causes.check: Check CPU temperature during boot, look for random crashes
Try factory reset or flash stock firmware

repair_steps: Check boot log for I2C errors and IC probe failures
If I2C error on bus 3 addr 0x60 = reball/replace MT6691ZXP
If storage errors = try firmware flash first
If CPU overheats during boot = reball CPU

no_charging.symptom: Phone does not charge, no charging indicator, or charges very slowly

possible_causes.check: Measure charging IC I2C communication, check VBUS voltage
Visual inspection, check CC line resistance
Check battery connector pins, measure VBAT
Check PMIC charging registers, measure VSYS

repair_steps: Check USB-C port for physical damage
Measure VBUS voltage (should be 5V from charger)
If PD_HW_FAIL = replace USB-C port or PD controller
If get_ibus failed = charging IC faulty, replace

no_network_signal.symptom: No network signal, SIM not detected, no service, or frequent call drops

possible_causes.reason: RF IC dead or solder joint broken
possible_causes.check: Check RF IC power supply, antenna connection
Check baseband version via ADB, check CCCI status in dmesg
Try another SIM card, check SIM connector pins
Check antenna connector, measure antenna impedance

repair_steps: Check SIM card and slot physically
If baseband empty = reball/replace modem IC
If SIM not detected = check SIM reader connector

no_display.symptom: Phone turns on (vibrates, plays sound) but screen is black or no display
indicators: Phone responds to calls/notifications but no screen

possible_causes.reason: Display flex cable loose or damaged
possible_causes.check: Reseat display connector, try known-good display
Check DSI data lines voltage, check display IC power

possible_causes.reason: Backlight driver dead — screen works but no light
possible_causes.check: Shine flashlight on screen — if you see faint image, backlight IC dead

repair_steps: Try known-good display to rule out display panel
If backlight dead = check/replace backlight IC
If DSI error in log = check display IC solder joints

no_wifi_bluetooth.symptom: WiFi or Bluetooth not working, cannot turn on WiFi, no networks found

possible_causes.reason: Combo IC dead or solder issue
possible_causes.check: Check WiFi IC power supply, antenna connection
Try factory reset, flash stock firmware

repair_steps: Try factory reset first (rules out software)
Replace combo IC if reball fails

no_audio.symptom: No sound from speaker, earpiece, or microphone not working
indicators: No audio devices detected in dumpsys

possible_causes.reason: Audio codec dead or solder issue
possible_causes.check: Check audio IC power supply and I2C communication
Check PA IC I2C (addr 0x34/0x36), measure speaker output
Test with known-good speaker, measure speaker impedance (4-8 ohm)

repair_steps: Check audio codec IC power and communication
If AudioError in log = check audio PA IC
Replace audio IC if communication fails

overheating.symptom: Phone gets very hot during use or while charging

possible_causes.check: Connect DC power supply — check current draw at idle (normal < 100mA)

possible_causes.reason: CPU overworking due to software or solder issue
possible_causes.check: Check CPU temperature zones, check if specific process uses high CPU
Check charging current (should be < rated max)
Visual battery inspection, check temperature during idle

repair_steps: Connect DC power supply and check idle current (< 100mA normal)
Use thermal camera to find hot spot on PCB
If capacitor area hot = find and remove shorted capacitor
If PMIC hot = check PMIC power rails for shorts
If battery hot = replace battery immediately

camera_not_working.symptom: Camera app crashes, black screen in camera, or camera not detected

possible_causes.reason: Camera module dead or connector loose
possible_causes.check: Reseat camera connector, try known-good camera
Measure camera voltage rails (VANA, VDIG, VIO)

repair_steps: Check camera voltage rails with multimeter
If power IC dead = replace camera PMIC

touch_not_working.symptom: Touchscreen not responding, ghost touches, or partial touch failure

possible_causes.check: Check I2C communication (addr 0x38/0x5D), check touch IC power

possible_causes.reason: Touch flex cable damaged or connector loose

repair_steps: If ghost touches = check for water damage around touch IC
If partial touch = digitizer damaged, replace display

fast_battery_drain.symptom: Battery drains very fast, phone dies within hours even with light use

possible_causes.reason: Battery degraded, actual capacity much lower than rated
possible_causes.check: Check battery health in dumpsys, compare design vs current capacity
Measure idle current with DC power supply (should be < 20mA in sleep)

possible_causes.reason: App or service keeping device awake

repair_steps: Measure idle current (< 20mA normal in deep sleep)
If high idle current = find leaky component with thermal camera
If software wakelock = identify and disable problematic app

fingerprint_not_working.symptom: Fingerprint sensor not detecting, cannot enroll, or slow recognition
indicators: Fingerprint service not available in dumpsys

possible_causes.check: Reseat fingerprint connector, try known-good sensor
Check fingerprint IC power and SPI/I2C communication

repair_steps: If sensor works on another board = motherboard IC issue

water_liquid_damage.symptom: Phone water/liquid damage ke baad band ya galat chal raha hai (corrosion)

possible_causes.check: Board ko alcohol + ultrasonic se clean karo, corrosion dhoondo

possible_causes.reason: Pani se PMIC ke pins short
possible_causes.check: PMIC area visual + diode mode se short check
Charging port + IC area clean aur check

repair_steps: Phone turant band karo, battery disconnect
Isopropyl alcohol (99%) + ultrasonic cleaner se board wash
Corrosion wale pins/components inspect aur reflow/replace

sim_not_detected.symptom: SIM card detect nahi ho raha / 'No SIM' aa raha hai
indicators: Dono slots me SIM nahi padh raha

possible_causes.reason: SIM tray/connector ke pins bend ya dirty
SIM ko power dene wali rail (VSIM) missing

repair_steps: SIM tray + connector pins check aur clean

random_reboot_restart.symptom: Phone apne aap random restart/reboot hota rehta hai

possible_causes.reason: Battery weak, load pe voltage gir jaata

repair_steps: Garmi me reboot ho to thermal/short dekho

ghost_touch.symptom: Screen apne aap touch hota hai (ghost touch), galat clicks

possible_causes.reason: Touch panel ya touch IC fault

possible_causes.check: Original charger se test, cheap charger hatao

repair_steps: Original charger se test (duplicate charger ghost touch deta hai)

no_backlight_dark_display.symptom: Display on hai (image faint dikhti torch se) par backlight nahi — screen kaali
indicators: Torch se halki image dikhti hai

possible_causes.reason: Backlight boost circuit ya BL driver fail

repair_steps: BL coil/diode/filter continuity check aur replace
Display replace agar panel LED fail

half_display_lines.symptom: Display adha kaala / lines aa rahi hain / colour galat
repair_steps: Doosri screen se test (panel vs board confirm)

microphone_not_working.symptom: Mic kaam nahi kar raha — call me saamne wale ko awaaz nahi jaati

possible_causes.check: Mic replace ya known-good se test

repair_steps: Recorder se konsा mic kharab confirm

proximity_sensor_fault.symptom: Call ke time screen off nahi hoti / proximity galat (ya auto-brightness fault)
indicators: Call me screen chalu reh jaati, kaan se dab jaati

gps_not_working.symptom: GPS location fix nahi hota / maps me location galat

slow_mobile_data.symptom: Mobile data slow / data nahi chal raha (signal hote hue bhi)

overheat_while_charging.symptom: Charging ke time phone bahut garm ho jaata hai

slow_charging.symptom: Charging bahut slow / fast charging nahi ho rahi

battery_drain_while_off.symptom: Phone off/standby me bhi battery jaldi khatam

possible_causes.check: Idle current draw measure (should be low mA)

storage_emmc_failure.symptom: Phone hang/boot nahi / storage corrupt (eMMC/UFS fail)

bootloop_after_update.symptom: Software update/flash ke baad bootloop ya recovery me atka

auto_power_off.symptom: Phone chalte-chalte apne aap band ho jaata (shutdown)

earpiece_no_sound.symptom: Call me earpiece se awaaz nahi (handsfree/speaker chalta hai)

green_line_amoled.symptom: AMOLED screen pe vertical green/pink line
repair_steps: AMOLED panel replace (ye panel-level fault hai)

face_unlock_front_cam_fault.symptom: Front camera / face unlock kaam nahi kar raha
